name: MidWest
description: This Amsterdam School building was designed in 1924 as two primary schools sharing a gymnasium. Its classroom windows face the inner gardens, while sculptural almost blind ends address the streets; two slender towers mark the Cabralstraat entrance.
funFact: The former gym is now a neighborhood canteen, retaining its gym floor, rings and climbing equipment. MidWest began using the building in 2012 and bought it in 2016, restoring historic details and turning its playgrounds into gardens that store rainwater.
